title: Shark dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7FE7FF' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7FE7FF' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='18' fill='#4FA8D8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#8FD8F0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='22' ry='10' fill='#C8ECFA'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M42 41 Q50 22 58 41 Z' fill='#3C8CC0' stroke='#7FC4E8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M79 54 Q92 42 94 52 Q90 58 95 66 Q82 62 79 54 Z' fill='#3C8CC0' stroke='#7FC4E8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- left pectoral fin (waving) -->
  <path d='M28 55 Q14 42 8 34 Q20 40 28 48 Z' fill='#3C8CC0' stroke='#7FC4E8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- right pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M72 55 Q84 60 88 68 Q78 64 70 60 Z' fill='#3C8CC0' stroke='#7FC4E8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d='M40 74 Q36 84 32 88' fill='none' stroke='#4FA8D8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 74 Q66 82 70 86' fill='none' stroke='#4FA8D8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shoes -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='90' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='2' fill='#1A3A5A'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 60 Q47 67 54 60' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <path d='M43 60 L44 64 L46 60 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <path d='M48 61 L49 65 L51 61 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- gills -->
  <path d='M34 55 Q36 59 34 63' fill='none' stroke='#2E6F9E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M31 56 Q33 60 31 64' fill='none' stroke='#2E6F9E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M20 30 L22 34 L20 38 L18 34 Z' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <path d='M85 28 L86.5 31 L88 28 L86.5 25 Z' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='35' r='2' fill='#FFB347'/>
</svg>
